_comment: What this plugin was last checked against. The service compares the live system with these values and notifies once per difference. Update after re-testing against a new Omarchy release.

/usr/share/omarchy/default/hypr/bindings.why: Stock workspace bindings (SUPER + number row, SUPER+scroll) that this plugin replaces

/usr/share/omarchy/shell/plugins/bar/wid.why: Stock Workspaces bar widget that this plugin's widget is derived from

hyprtasking._comment: Builds whose overview grid places monitor-bound workspaces in id order (raybbian/hyprtasking#138). Other builds show the second monitor's tiles offset by one after a slot change.
